words.translation: Memorial Day for Victims of Communist Dictatorship (February 25th)
February 25th (date of MP Béla Kovács's arrest by Soviet troops in 1947)
unlawful abduction of Smallholders Party General Secretary to the Gulag
Memorial Day for Hungarian Victims of the Holocaust (April 16th)
April 16th (marking the 1944 establishment of the first ghettos)
forced ghettoization and deportation of Hungarian Jewish citizens in 1944
